episodes.program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g))
         ;; The non-zero bounding box is the original outer rectangle.
         (cells (positions-of g (lambda (v) (!= v 0))))
         (bb (bbox-of-cells cells))
         (r1 (first bb))
         (c1 (second bb))
         (r2 (third bb))
         (c2 (fourth bb))
         (outer (at g r1 c1))
         ;; The other non-zero color forms the solid inner rectangle.
         (inner-cells
           (filter (lambda (p)
             (!= (at g (first p) (second p)) outer))
             cells))
         (ibb (bbox-of-cells inner-cells))
         (ir1 (first ibb))
         (ic1 (second ibb))
         (ir2 (third ibb))
         (ic2 (fourth ibb))
         (inner (at g ir1 ic1))
         (inner-h (+ 1 (- ir2 ir1)))
         (inner-w (+ 1 (- ic2 ic1)))
         ;; Expand uniformly, capped by both inner size and every grid edge.
         (thick (min inner-h inner-w r1 c1
                     (- (- h 1) r2) (- (- w 1) c2)))
         (nr1 (- r1 thick))
         (nc1 (- c1 thick))
         (nr2 (+ r2 thick))
         (nc2 (+ c2 thick)))
    (cellmap g
      (r c v)
      (if (and (>= r nr1) (<= r nr2)
               (>= c nc1) (<= c nc2)
               (not (and (>= r r1) (<= r r2)
                         (>= c c1) (<= c c2))))
          inner
          v)))))
